Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    ncols=[j for j in range(w) if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][j]!=bg]
    # assume single-cell-wide vertical line of unique non-bg color

    lc=ncols[0]
    rest={(i,j,v) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j] not in (bg,lcolor)}
    bcol=list(v for i,j,v in rest)[0]
    cells=list(rest)
    cmin=min(j for _,j,_ in cells); cmax=max(j for _,j,_ in cells)
    rmin=min(i for i,_,_ in cells); rmax=max(i for i,_,_ in cells)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lc=None; lcolv=None
    for j in range(w):
        v={inp[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(v)==1 and next(iter(v))!=bg: lc=j; lcolv=next(iter(v))
    cells=[(i,j,inp[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j] not in (bg,lcolv)]
    bcol=cells[0][2]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,j,v in cells),max(i for i,j,v in cells)
    c0,c1=min(j for i,j,v in cells),max(j for i,j,v in cells)
    s=(lc+1)-c0
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0+s,c1+s+1): out[i][j]=bcol
    for i in range(h): out[i][lc]=lcolv; out[i][c1+s+1]=8
    return out

# f crashes on demo3 because line is a HORIZONTAL row (row 1). Fix: detect line orientation.
def solve(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # vertical or horizontal line color = non-bg uniform full-line
    lv=None; lr=None
    for j in range(w):
        if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and next(iter({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)}))!=bg:
            lv=next(iter({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})); lr=j; orient='v'
    for i in range(h):
        if len({inp[i][j] for j in range(w)})==1 and next(iter({inp[i][j] for j in range(w)}))!=bg:
            lv=next(iter({inp[i][j] for j in range(w)})); lr=i; orient='h'
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j] not in (bg,lv)]
    bcol=inp[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,j in cells),max(i for i,j in cells)
    c0,c1=min(j for i,j in cells),max(j for i,j in cells)
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h): out[i][lr]=lv   # restore line
    if orient=='v':
        # shift blob horizontally so near edge lands at lr+1
        s=(lr+1)-c0
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j+s]=bcol
        for i in range(h): out[i][c1+s+1]=8
    else:
        # shift vertically so near edge (r0) lands at lr+1
        s=(lr+1)-r0
        for i,j in cells: out[i+s][j]=bcol
        for j in range(w): out[r1+s+1][j]=8
    return out
for p in (1,2,3):
    print(p, solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
pred=solve(G['Test input'])
for i in range(28): print(''.join(str(x) for x in pred[i]))

G=load()
def analyze(p):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; do=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    h,w=len(di),len(di[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in di for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line
    lc=None;ornt=None;lv=None
    for j in range(w):
        if len({di[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and next(iter({di[i][j] for i in range(h)}))!=bg:
            lv=next(iter({di[i][j] for i in range(h)}));lc=j;ornt='v';break
    if ornt is None:
        for i in range(h):
            if len({di[i][j] for j in range(w)})==1 and next(iter({di[i][j] for j in range(w)}))!=bg:
                lv=next(iter({di[i][j] for j in range(w)}));lc=i;ornt='h'
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if di[i][j] not in (bg,lv)]
    bcol=di[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,j in cells),max(i for i,j in cells);c0,c1=min(j for i,j in cells),max(j for i,j in cells)
    # output: blob & 8 positions
    oblob=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if do[i][j]==bcol]
    o8=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if do[i][j]==8]
    orb0,orb1=min(i for i,j in oblob),max(i for i,j in oblob)
    oc0,oc1=min(j for i,j in o8),max(j for i,j in o8)
    print(p,'H W',h,w,'line',ornt,lc,'lv',lv,'blobcolor',bcol,'blobbbox',(r0,r1,c0,c1),'origpos',min((i,j) for i,j in cells))
    print('   out blob bbox',(min(i for i,j in oblob),max(i for i,j in oblob),min(j for i,j in oblob),max(j for i,j in oblob)),'n',len(oblob))
    print('   out 8 bbox',(min(i for i,j in o8),max(i for i,j in o8),min(j for i,j in o8),max(j for i,j in o8)),'n',len(o8))
    return dict(locals())
for p in (1,2,3,4,5,6): analyze(p)

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lv=None;lc=None;ornt=None
    for j in range(w):
        v={inp[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(v)==1 and next(iter(v))!=bg: lv=v.pop();lc=j;ornt='v';break
    if ornt is None:
        for i in range(h):
            v={inp[i][j] for j in range(w)}
            if len(v)==1 and next(iter(v))!=bg: lv=v.pop();lc=i;ornt='h';break
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]!=bg and inp[i][j]!=lv]
    bcol=inp[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if ornt=='v':
        for i in range(h): out[i][lc]=lv
        ms=min(j for i,j in cells); mx=max(j for i,j in cells)
        if ms > lc: s=(lc+1)-ms; bc=mx+s+1
        else: s=(lc-1)-mx; bc=ms+s-1
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j+s]=bcol
        for i in range(h): out[i][bc]=8
    else:
        for j in range(w): out[lc][j]=lv
        mh=min(i for i,j in cells); Mx=max(i for i,j in cells)
        if mh > lc: s=(lc+1)-mh; br=Mx+s+1
        else: s=(lc-1)-Mx; br=mh+s-1
        for i,j in cells: out[i+s][j]=bcol
        for j in range(w): out[br][j]=8
    return out
for p in (1,2,3,4,5,6,7): print(p, solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lv=None;lc=None;ornt=None
    for j in range(w):
        v={inp[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(v)==1 and next(iter(v))!=bg: lv=v.pop();lc=j;ornt='v';break
    if ornt is None:
        for i in range(h):
            v={inp[i][j] for j in range(w)}
            if len(v)==1 and next(iter(v))!=bg: lv=v.pop();lc=i;ornt='h';break
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]!=bg and inp[i][j]!=lv]
    bcol=inp[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if ornt=='v':
        for i in range(h): out[i][lc]=lv
        ms=min(j for i,j in cells); mx=max(j for i,j in cells)
        if ms > lc: s=(lc+1)-ms; bc=mx+s+1
        else: s=(lc-1)-mx; bc=ms+s-1
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j+s]=bcol
        for i in range(h): out[i][bc]=8
    else:
        for j in range(w): out[lc][j]=lv
        mh=min(i for i,j in cells); Mx=max(i for i,j in cells)
        if mh > lc: s=(lc+1)-mh; br=Mx+s+1
        else: s=(lc-1)-Mx; br=mh+s-1
        for i,j in cells: out[i+s][j]=bcol
        for j in range(w): out[br][j]=8
    return out
for p in (1,2,3,4,5,6,7): print(p, solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
ti=G['Test input']
ans=solve(ti)
import json
print(json.dumps(ans))

import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find separator: full-uniform row or col of a non-bg color (must be the unique such line)
    cand=[]
    for j in range(w):
        if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][j]!=bg: cand.append(('v',j,inp[0][j]))
    for i in range(h):
        if len({inp[i][j] for j in range(w)})==1 and inp[i][0]!=bg: cand.append(('h',i,inp[i][0]))
    kind,lpos,color=cand[0]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if kind=='v':
        out[lpos]=[color]*h
        sh=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]==color]
        rs=[r for r,_ in sh]; cs=[c for _,c in sh]
        dr=(lpos+1)-max(cs)   # shift toward line (left) so shape right edge = lpos+1
        br=max(cs)+dr+1       # bar just right of moved shape
        for r,c in sh: out[r][c+dr]=color
        for r in range(h): out[r][br]=8
    else:
        out[lpos]=[color]*w
        sh=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]==color]
        rs=[r for r,_ in sh]; cs=[c for _,c in sh]
        dr=lpos-min(rs)
        bc=min(rs)-dr-1
        for r,c in sh: out[r-dr][c]=color
        for c in range(w): out[bc][c]=8
    return out

# verify on all demos
ok=True
for p in (1,2,3,4,5,6,7):
    r=solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    ok&=r; print(p,'match' if r else 'MISMATCH')
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAIL')
ti=G['Test input']
ans=solve(ti)
for r in ans: print(r)
print(json.dumps(ans))

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cand=[]
    for j in range(w):
        if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][j]!=bg: cand.append(('v',j))
    for i in range(h):
        if len({inp[i][j] for j in range(w)})==1 and inp[i][0]!=bg: cand.append(('h',i))
    kind,lpos=cand[0]
    sepc = inp[0][lpos] if kind=='v' else inp[lpos][0]
    # find shape cells (non-bg, non-sep)
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j] not in (bg,sepc)]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if kind=='v':
        # direction: toward separator column lpos; shape spans cols csmin..csmax
        csmin=min(j for _,j,_ in cells); csmax=max(j for _,j,_ in cells)
        # move left/right toward line until adjacent (col lpos+1 or lpos-1)
        dr=(lpos-csmax)>0   # 1 if to the right of line -> move left
        d=abs(lpos-csmin)-1 if csmin<lpos else abs(lpos-csmax)-1
        dsign=-1 if (csmax<lpos) else 1
        d=abs(d)*dsign
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+d]=v
        bar_col = csmax+d+1 if csmax<lpos else csmin+d-1
        for r in range(h): out[r][bar_col]=8
        out[lpos]=[sepc]*w
    else:
        rsmin=min(i for i,_,_ in cells); rsmax=max(i for i,_,_ in cells)
        dsign=-1 if rsmax<lpos else 1
        d=abs(rsmin-lpos) if rsmax<lpos else abs(rsmax-lpos)+... 
        # distance: need near edge adjacent: gap = distance - 1
        if rsmax<lpos:
            d=(rsmax+1)-rsmax? 
            g=lpos-(rsmax+1)          # rows between shape bottom and sep top
            d=g
            br=rsmax-d                  # bar row above moved blob
            out[rsmax-d][0:c+0]=[9]# placeholder
            for r,c,v in cells: out[r-d][c]=v
            for c in range(w): out[br][c]=8
            out[lpos]=[sepc]*w
        else:
            g=(rsmin)-... 
            g=rsmin-(lpos-1)           # rows between shape top and sep bottom
            d=g
            br=rsmin+d+1               # bar below moved blob
            for r,c,v in cells: out[r+d][c]=v
            for c in range(w): out[br][c]=8
            out[lpos]=[sepc]*w
    return out

        for rr,rrr in zip(o,b):

def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    kind=None; lpos=None; sc=None
    for j in range(w):
        colv=[inp[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        if len(set(colv))==1 and colv[0]!=bg: kind,lpos,sc='v',j,colv[0]; break
    if kind is None:
        for i in range(h):
            rowv=[inp[i][j] for j in range(w)]
            if len(set(rowv))==1 and rowv[0]!=bg: kind,lpos,sc='h',i,rowv[0]; break
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bg and inp[r][c]!=sc]

import collections
def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # separator: full uniform non-bg line; prefer the one whose color count equals full dimension
    vs=[j for j in range(w) if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and all(inp[i][j]!=bg for i in range(h))]

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter as C

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=C(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    vs=[j for j in range(w) if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and all(inp[i][j]!=bg for i in range(h))]
    hs=[i for i in range(h) if len({inp[i][j] for j in range(w)})==1 and all(inp[i][j]!=bg for i in range(w))]
    kind='v' if vs else 'h'; lpos=vs[0] if vs else hs[0]; sc=inp[0][lpos] if kind=='v' else inp[lpos][0]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if kind=='v':
        for r in range(h): out[r][lpos]=sc
    else:
        for c in range(w): out[lpos][c]=sc
    cells=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c] not in (bg,sc)]
    rs=[r for r,_,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c,_ in cells]
    rmin,rmax=min(rs),max(rs); cmin,cmax=min(cs),max(cs)
    # move toward separator until bbox is flush against it
    if kind=='v':
        dirc=1 if lpos>cmax else -1
        sh=0
        while True:
            nm=(cmin+sh+dirc<=lpos-1) and (cmax+sh+dirc>=lpos+1)
            if nm: break
            sh+=dirc
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+sh]=v
        bc = cmax+sh+1  # bar on far side of object from sep
        for r in range(h): out[r][bc]=8
    else:
        dirc=1 if lpos>rmax else -1
        sr=0
        while True:
            nr=(rmin+sr+dirc<=lpos-1) and (rmax+sr+dirc>=lpos+1)
            if nr: break
            sr+=dirc
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r+sr][c]=v
        br=rmax+sr+1
        for c in range(w): out[br][c]=8
    return out
for p in range(1,9):
    o=solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); b=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print(p,'MATCH' if o==b else 'MISMATCH')
